messages:
Ana (DevEx): Hey team — spontaneous LAN tonight? I can swing by the office with a projector and a couple of folding chairs. thinking 6:30-10pm. who wants in? :popcorn:
Matt: in if there's space. bringing my Switch + Smash copy. can anyone bring a dock?
Priya: I can bring a dock and a couple of Joy-Cons. also bringing a small speaker (bluetooth) if we need music.
Noah: Imight come with my PC, but fyi my GPU takes up 3 slots so I need a bigger case lift. also I have a WIRELESS adapter that sometimes disconnects; prefer wired.
Ben (Infra): building maintenance locked a few cabinets today so access to the 2nd-floor port cluster is limited. recommend everyone bring a short CAT6 patch cable. I can reserve 4 ports on the 1st-floor switch.
Ana (DevEx): Good to know. @Ben can you set aside ports and disable AP client isolation for tonight? Remote Play lobbies will hate isolation.
Ben (Infra): Yup, reserved ports 11-14 on the 1st-floor switch. Will disable client isolation from 18:00-23:00.
Matt: Oof thanks. Also, who has extra USB-A to USB-C cables? controllers + powerbanks need them.
Priya: I have 3 cables. will bring.
Noah: Imight be short on cables but have a D-Link 5-port switch and a couple of ethernet couplers (in case we need to extend).
Ana (DevEx): Quick poll: Smash, Rocket League, Overcooked, or speedrun watch party? react with :one: :two: :three: :four: in next 15m.
Matt: :one: Smash
Priya: :three: Overcooked (chaos pls)
Noah: :two: Rocket League
Ben (Infra): :two: Rocket League
setup-bot: Scheduled event: LAN Night @ Office 18:30 - setup checklist posted to #random. Link: https://calendar.local/event/1765680005
Ana (DevEx): Looks like Rocket League wins. we'll do two TVs for 2v2, projector for viewer matches.
Matt: Anyone up for a 3v3 rotation? Ill bring an ethernet spool so we can hardline hosts.
Priya: I'll bring snacks: chips + salsa. any dietary restrictions?
Noah: gluten-free person here, yay chips. also please bring napkins.
Ben (Infra): PSA: if anyone wants to host a vacant lobby for friends, DM me first so I can check NAT. building NAT can be punchy.
Ana (DevEx): Perfect. I'll pin setup checklist and a map to the office mains (where the best outlets are).
Matt: final q: anyone wants to try the indie "cozy-couch" rotation after Rocket League? quick 20-min sessions.
Priya: yes please. good cooldown games after competitive matches.
Ana (DevEx): Great. see you all 18:30. tagging folks who offered gear: @Priya (dock), @Noah (switch), @Matt (spare controller).
